newsitem.title: USA: TCI buys stake in LodgeNet unit.
newsitem.headline: TCI buys stake in LodgeNet unit.

text.p: TCI Satellite Entertainment Inc, a division of Tele-Communications Inc, has bought an interest in the residential communications unit of LodgeNet Entertainment Corp, LodgeNet said on Monday.
TCI bought 4.99 percent of ResNet Communications Inc's stock for $5.4 million, it said.

In addition, TCI will advance ResNet $34.6 million over the next five years, which will be used to purchase satellite receiver equipment, in exchange for a note that will convert into a 36.99 percent equity interest in ResNet.
Under the agreement, ResNet will have long-term access to TCI's direct broadcast satellite signals nationwide.

TCI will have an option to increase its ownership in ResNet by an additional 13.01 percent, exercisable after three years, in return for an additional cash investment based upon the then fair market value.
"This agreement will significantly reduce ResNet's capital costs and increase programming options for our subscribers," said Tim Flynn, president and chief executive of LodgeNet.
Tele-Communications Inc recently announced it will spin-off TCI to the holders of the company's TCI Group common stock. The spin-off is expected to be completed in the fourth quarter.
LodgeNet is a specialized communications company. Its ResNet unit installs and operates private cable television systems in apartment complexes throughout the United States.
